verdict.rationale: Blink Shell's own interface is a first-party command line. It ships built-in commands (ssh, mosh, scp/sftp, curl, config, ls/cp/grep and other Unix utilities), and you can run small Python or Lua scripts with redirection, though pipes are not supported. However, nothing in the pack shows this CLI is meant for, or usable in, AI-native or agent-driven workflows. It is an interactive iOS terminal, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface. Missing for 10: agent-invokable or scriptable CLI usage outside the iOS app, AI-workflow documentation, pipe support, independent corroboration of automation use.
